factors such as skin color). However, these guidelines are not specific for individuals with underly­
ing conditions or diseases. The United States Institute of Medicine Recommended Dietary Allow­
ance of vitamin D is 400 IU per day for children younger than 1 year of age, 600 IU per day for 
children at least 1 year of age and adults up to 70 years, and 800 IU per day for older adults. The 
AAP recommendations for children is similar to the IOM but that of the pediatric endocrine
